environment.description: Same FastAPI application deployed behind an Envoy proxy sidecar (v1.28) in an ECS Fargate task. The Envoy configuration includes a local rate limit filter applied at the virtual host level with a token bucket of 2 requests per 30-second window per unique source IP + session cookie tuple, specifically scoped to routes matching POST methods on paths /transfer and /change-email. The rate limiter returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header and closes the connection after the second request in the window. Additionally, the ECS task's network configuration places the service in a private subnet accessible only through an internal NLB that strips X-Forwarded-For spoofing, ensuring the source IP seen by Envoy is the true client IP from the NLB's TCP passthrough. The rate limit descriptor uses a composite key of {remote_address + cookie:session} meaning even if an attacker rotates IPs, the session binding prevents replay across different source addresses for the same session.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, private subnet, internal NLB (TCP passthrough) -> Envoy sidecar -> app container
config.network: private subnet, NLB TCP passthrough (no X-Forwarded-For injection possible)
